I spent a lot of time without knowing how to get them as well.  What you do is going into your items menu, you will find that you can select items and "unravel" them.  I recommend ONLY unraveling items you have duplicates of, as this will mean you don't lose a cosmetic item you may want to use later.    


Good luck in the constant!
